_comment: The WBW trail, baked at build time so the app never spends a routing quota or
needs a network to draw it. Regenerate from route.gpx in the project root;
nothing in the code hard-codes the point count.
Source: route.gpx — the organisers' Google Maps walking route exported via
GoogleMapsToGPX, https://maps.app.goo.gl/TXqetyrqvakUbD8b9 — so this is Google's
own path, not a re-route. It replaced an OSRM foot-profile reconstruction over the
same waypoints, which followed different ways and strayed up to 705m from this.
polyline is Google's encoded-polyline format at precision 5, lossless here because
the GPX carries exactly 5 decimal places. 750 points.
distanceMetres is summed from the track; the GPX carries no timings, so there is
deliberately no duration field rather than an invented one.
